indicators.text: OFAC SDN delta batch designates >=3 shadow-fleet crude/product tankers (with IMO/MMSI) or a third-country dual-use procurement network.
BIS or USTR places a rule stay, suspension extension, or Entity List expansion on Federal Register public inspection within 14 days of a scheduled deadline.
An FAO food price index moves on the month by a robust z of 3.5 or more against its own 120 prior monthly changes, and by at least 2%.

indicators.rule: any of: ECB abs(z) >= 3.5 and abs(change_pct) >= 1.0 (5 business days, 250 prior); GEM abs(z) >= 3.5 and abs(change_pct) >= 2.0 (1 month, 60 prior); WFP abs(z) >= 3.5 and abs(median_change_pct) >= 5.0 (1 month, 60 prior medians)
indicators.text: A watched country's currency moves against the US dollar outside its own range in any of three readings, each against its own history: the ECB daily rate over five business days (robust z of 3.5 or more against its 250 prior five-day changes, and at least 1%); the World Bank's official monthly average over one month (z 3.5 or more against its 60 prior monthly changes, and at least 2%); or the median one-month change of WFP's market rates (z 3.5 or more against its 60 prior medians, and at least 5%).
Brent, WTI or Henry Hub moves over five trading days by a robust z of 3.5 or more against its own 250 prior five-day changes, and by at least 5%.
A country's median three-month change in local market food prices sits a robust z of 3.5 or more from its own 60 prior monthly medians, and is at least 10%.

warning_problems.title: Sanctions enforcement surge or export-control cliff
warning_problems.watch_condition: Continuous monitoring of OFAC SDN delta publications and BIS/USTR Federal Register public-inspection filings.
warning_problems.issue_on_change: Issue a warning item when OFAC designates a maritime tanker fleet or dual-use procurement ring, or when an export-control stay approaches within 14 days without a filed extension.
warning_problems.deactivation: Rule stay or final rule is published in the Federal Register and affected shipping/trade corridors adjust.

hypotheses.title: Coordinated enforcement tightening against shadow-fleet energy revenue or dual-use transshipment
Calibrated diplomatic truce extension via synchronized BIS/USTR administrative stays
Administrative publication lag or technical identifier correction (artefact)

warning_problems.title: Economic stress in a watched country
warning_problems.watch_condition: Continuous measurement of each watched country's currency against the US dollar (HW-IND-4) and its local market food prices (HW-IND-6), with the Brent, WTI and Henry Hub benchmarks (HW-IND-5) as the outside reference. Watched countries are those in config/wfp_countries.json (Watchfloor's zones). HW-IND-4 is read from the ECB's daily rates, the World Bank's official monthly averages and WFP's market rates; the page shows which each country has.
warning_problems.issue_on_change: Each anomaly item for a watched country, and each energy anomaly, carries its indicator, the hypothesis it bears on and its state. Headwind issues measurements only; a warning on a country is a judgment for an analyst, made with these items and outside them.
warning_problems.deactivation: The country's currency and local food prices are back within their own ranges for three readings in a row, or the country leaves the watched list.

hypotheses.title: Stress within the country: its currency and local food prices move outside their own ranges while the energy benchmarks stay within theirs
Stress from outside: an energy price shock reaches the country's local food prices while its currency holds
Artefact: a change of method or data, such as a redenomination, a change in WFP's markets or commodities, a short or late series, or a base effect
